The submitted answer (7, -10) is incorrect; the correct pair is (-7, 10).

Let u = a − 2b + 3c and v = 2a + 3b − 4c. Then v − u = a + 5b − 7c, so points on the line through u and v are

u + t(v − u) = (1+t)a + (−2+5t)b + (3−7t)c.

For this to have no a-component, we need t = −1. This gives −7b + 10c, which is 2u − v. So the point pb + qc on the line is (p, q) = (−7, 10).

The submitted vector 7b − 10c is the negative of this point. It lies on the line only if some t gives 1+t = 0 and the b and c coefficients equal 7 and −10. With t = −1 the coefficients are −7 and 10, so it does not lie on the line.
